name: New York Supreme Cheesecake | 1.5G Eclair Handcraft
description:
New York Supreme Cheesecake | 1.5G Éclair Handcraft | HYMAN | REC 
The new fan favorite, elevated. Each Éclair is handcrafted with 1g of premium flower and infused with 0.5g of cold-cured, single-source rosin. Finished with our signature glass tip and H2O brushed for a perfect seal and an even burn — all for the perfect HY. 
GET BAKED TWICE 💨 
Strain Type: Hybrid 
Flavors: Sweet, Citrus, Grapefruit 
Aromas: Pungent, Diesel, Strawberry 
Experience: Sociable, Happy, Creative
